description: Defines the CRLSet class for managing Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs), including parsing, checking revocation status, and testing utilities within the net namespace.

classes.name: CRLSet
classes.description: Represents a set of Certificate Revocation Lists (CRLs) with methods for parsing, checking revocation status, and testing.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses CRL set data and outputs a CRLSet object.

methods.name: CheckSPKI
methods.description: Checks if a given SubjectPublicKeyInfo hash is listed as revoked.

methods.name: CheckSerial
methods.description: Checks if a serial number associated with an issuer SPKI hash is revoked.

methods.name: CheckSubject
methods.description: Checks if a subject name and SPKI hash are revoked.

methods.name: IsKnownInterceptionKey
methods.description: Determines if a given SPKI hash is used for interception.

methods.name: IsExpired
methods.description: Checks if the CRL set has expired.

methods.name: sequence
methods.description: Returns the sequence number of the CRL set.

methods.name: CrlsForTesting
methods.description: Returns internal CRL list for testing.

methods.name: BuiltinCRLSet
methods.description: Returns the default built-in CRL set.

methods.name: EmptyCRLSetForTesting
methods.description: Returns an empty CRL set for testing.

methods.name: ExpiredCRLSetForTesting
methods.description: Returns an expired CRL set for testing.

methods.name: ForTesting
methods.description: Creates a CRL set for testing with specific parameters.
